line.name: AVO Syncro 10th Anniversary Limited Edition
line.description: A one-off limited edition tied to AVO Syncro Nicaragua's 10th anniversary (not a new permanent Syncro variant), released to mark 10 years since Syncro Nicaragua's 2015 debut, timed to Avo Uvezian's birthday (March 22) tradition of annual limited editions. Announced March 13, 2025; shipped to retailers April 3, 2025. Box-pressed, 20-count collectible box, ~3,400 boxes allocated to the US.
line.wrapper: Ecuadorian (one retailer specifies Ecuadorian Connecticut - unverified detail, single-sourced)
line.filler: Nicaraguan and Dominican (one retailer's product copy also mentions Peruvian filler - unconfirmed elsewhere, likely retail-copy over-specification, not added as a confirmed fact)

vitolas.name: Diadema (Diademas Finas)
vitolas.notes: Matches the Mac photo. One source, Cigar Coop's own announcement, states '60 x 6-5/8' which appears to be a transposition/garbling error rather than a genuine 60-ring cigar - the 3-retailer consensus of 6.625x50 is treated as the reliable figure.

research_notes: See notes above on the wrapper/filler single-sourced details and the size discrepancy.
